summary: New Pacific Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting financial results for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, along with operational updates on its Carangas project. The filing covers administrative mining contracts, a preliminary economic assessment, community agreements, and a bought deal equity financing. No special situation event is present. The net loss was $4.19 million for the year. Management appointments were made permanent but are not abrupt departures. Routine financial reporting, no M&A, tender, or restructuring activity. What to watch: project developments and financing updates.
